title: Practice Plan — Thursday AM, three lanes
servesOrScale: one squad of twelve, three lanes, one coach
constraints: two and a half hours of pool time
notes: The three lanes are three tracks against a single lane resource of maxConcurrent 3, so the warm-up, kick and cooldown resolve as genuine three-way parallelism while the sprint set serialises on the blocks. The main sets are variable with different defaults per lane; the sprint set opens on a compound 'all' across the three of them. The whiteboard talk is the coach's manual gate and is placed in the deck track after the warm-up watch, which is what it actually waits for.
